entities.summary: Ethan Pocic is an American professional football center for the Cleveland Browns of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the LSU Tigers. Pocic has also played the guard position. He was selected by the Seattle Seahawks in the second round of the 2017 NFL draft.
